verdict.rationale: Gecko has scan schedules, webhooks, and an API to trigger scans/read data (gecko-security-docs-10), plus PR checks and ticket creation triggered by findings (gecko-security-docs-5, gecko-security-docs-6), which provide some event-driven automation, but there's no evidence of a user-facing rules engine where an AI-native user can define custom conditional trigger-action rules. missing for 10: a documented rules/policy definition interface, custom trigger conditions beyond scan/PR events, and independent confirmation the automation behaves reliably as configured.
